research_summary.tagline: With You, Wherever Life Takes You

company_info.name: Zimswitch
company_info.tagline: With You, Wherever Life Takes You
company_info.designation: Sole National Electronic Funds Switch and clearing house for Zimbabwe (designated by Reserve Bank of Zimbabwe)

services_products.name: ZIPIT
services_products.description: Mobile money transfer service with P2P, Smart, and Pay variants for instant person-to-person transfers across banks.

services_products.name: ATM Services
services_products.description: Interbank ATM cash withdrawal services allowing customers to use any Zimswitch-enabled ATM regardless of their bank.

services_products.name: POS Payments
services_products.description: Point of Sale card purchases and contactless payments (Tap to Pay) at merchants nationwide.

services_products.name: Zimswitch Online
services_products.description: E-commerce payment gateway enabling secure online transactions for businesses and consumers.

services_products.name: ZEEPAY
services_products.description: Electronic Funds Transfer solution for businesses to process bulk payments including salaries, supplier payments, and disbursements.

services_products.name: Clearing & Settlement
services_products.description: Core infrastructure service providing clearing and settlement operations for all member financial institutions.

services_products.name: Risk Management
services_products.description: Fraud prevention and risk management services including fraud reporting portal for the financial ecosystem.

services_products.name: Training Services
services_products.description: Training and development services for member institutions on payment systems and security.

value_propositions: Secure, seamless payment experiences across all channels
Financial flexibility - access your money wherever you are
Trusted processing with emphasis on fraud prevention
Single switch connecting all banks and financial institutions
key_features: Designated by Reserve Bank of Zimbabwe as sole national switch
certifications_awards: Reserve Bank of Zimbabwe designated national switch

raw_content.main_page: Zimswitch operates as Zimbabwe's central payment infrastructure provider, enabling electronic fund transfers, clearing, and settlement services across the financial ecosystem. Designated by the Reserve Bank of Zimbabwe as the sole national electronic funds switch.
